更新：我刚刚意识到当我保存此工作流程时，积极条件没有连接。要使其正常工作，只需将“Positive Conditioning”上的“CONDITIONING”连接到“Apply ControlNet”上的“Positive”即可。由于某种原因，当我保存工作流程时，它没有连接。我希望你们中的大多数人已经足够了解 Comfy 来解决这个问题，但对于任何想知道为什么会出现错误的人来说。

这是我的 SDXL 批量提示工作流程，它不仅允许我通过一次单击创建数千个图像，而且对不同的提示集应用不同的权重以获得疯狂的结果。您可以绕过不同的组或激活它们以满足您的目标。它已成为一个美妙的多用途工作流程。如有任何疑问，请随时提问！

您需要 ComfyUI Inspire Pack，使用管理器下载任何缺少的节点。

在 InspirePack 内，将提示 txt 文件放入提示示例文件夹中。

提示的格式应如下所示：

正面：一个飘逸的泻湖，湖水质地清澈，闪烁着蔚蓝和海蓝宝石的渐变色，周围环绕着高耸的悬崖，具有深褐色和赭色的锯齿状纹理，装饰着层叠的藤蔓，藤蔓散发着黄绿色和洋红色色调的生物发光孢子；

负面：

----------

正面：梦幻般的城市景观，其中摩天大楼具有分形纹理，其表面不断变化着银色和靛蓝色的棱柱图案，由具有乳白色光泽的半透明走道连接，并且居住着全息生物，它们在电蓝色和紫红色的色调中忽隐忽现；

负面：

----------

您可以批量执行 PC 可以处理的任意数量的提示。如果您遇到任何有关内存的错误，请在每批中使用较少的提示。

o.en:
UPDATE: I just realized when I saved this workflow, the Positive Conditioning wasn't connected. To get it to work, just connect the "CONDITIONING" on "Positive Conditioning" to the "Positive" on "Apply ControlNet". For some reason this was not connected when I saved the workflow. I hope most of you already know enough about Comfy to have fixed this, but for anyone wondering why if they get an error.

This is my SDXL Batch Prompt workflow that allows me to not only create thousands of images in a single click, but apply different weights to different sets of the prompt to get insane results. You can bypass the different groups or activate them to suit what your goal is. It's become a wonderful multi use workflow. Any questions, feel free to ask!

You need ComfyUI Inspire Pack, download any missing nodes with the manager.

Inside the InspirePack, put the prompt txt file in the prompt example folder.

Prompts should be formatted like this:

positive: An ethereal lagoon where the water has a pellucid texture, shimmering in gradients of cerulean and aquamarine, surrounded by towering cliffs with a crenellated texture in shades of umber and sienna, adorned with cascading vines that glow with bioluminescent spores in hues of chartreuse and magenta;

negative:

----------

positive: A phantasmagorical cityscape where skyscrapers have a fractal texture, their surfaces constantly shifting in prismatic patterns of silver and indigo, connected by translucent walkways with an opalescent sheen, and populated by holographic beings that flicker in and out of existence in shades of electric blue and fuchsia;

negative:

----------

You can do batches of however many prompts your PC can handle. If you get any errors about memory, use less prompts in each batch.
